snippet.title: The Carbonara Tales – Official Trailer | Free Rage Platformer
snippet.description:
ooh, a free orange... 🍊 What could possibly go wrong?
Free on iOS & Android → https://talesofcarbonara.com

The Carbonara Tales is a free capybara rage-platformer. Looks cute, plays vicious.

📱 App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6809626463
🤖 Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.talesofcarbonara.game
🌐 Website: https://talesofcarbonara.com

What's inside:
• 5 short levels (a perfect run takes 40–75 seconds)
• Traps that lie to you
• 50 hand-drawn death illustrations
• Retro console look with adjustable CRT grain
• 18 skins
• Speedrun mode with splits
• Free to play, with ads

Made by one person, built.

Streaming or making videos about the game? Go ahead: no restrictions, monetization is fine.

#indiegame #platformer #capybara
